name: 41 (2026-11-28 morning)
what: Track F reads its passage to 200 M and starts the full checksum pass; Track A reads the run for its condition (c) and the failed retest member; Track D reads its first G3 member and queues the mesh leg as ruled
note: Release core-v0.9 is on main since 2026-11-28 (CLAUDE.md row; executables .work/build_gpu_v09 and .work/build_cpu_v09; the orchestrator's note to all): new runs use it; it changes the deposit at level faces without an option, so compare members only within one build. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0047 to 0051. The shared queue calls an entry done only when its jobs completed (`nrpic-queue status` shows entries that ended without completing). After git merge main: nrpic-run finish closes runs continued in place; finish and verify keep a checksum cache. The week's usage is budgeted: keep to the time given. Close a finished run before you analyse it; every number with its run id; prediction before every new run or analysis; figures made by registered scripts and looked at; at most 6 cores.

items.extra: Extra for this session: about forty-five minutes. The continuation of the passage (queue entry q0091) has ended: the tracker record reaches t = 200 M (decision 0048 item 2(a)). (1) Check that its jobs completed, close the run (nrpic-run finish), and FIRST start the full checksum pass of the stage check detached in the background (`harness/bin/nrpic-stage verify F-hills G1 --full`, log under scratch/F-hills/tmp/; about 2 TB, hours; do not wait for it). (2) Read the record to 200 M with your registered readers (b21_a2_state.py, b34_horizons.py), figures looked at; judge predictions D35-1 to D35-9; horizon numbers with their residual. (3) stage/G1/EVIDENCE.md and CHECKLIST C8 with the record to 200 M and the health checks; stage collect, verify (cache), report. (4) One line to the orchestrator (outbox) with the run ids, the state of the full checksum pass and where its log is: the gate is signed on that line and on the pass. Nothing of the restart files is deleted.

Extra for this session (about seventy-five minutes). Gate G2 stays not passed; rulings: decision 0051 item 4 (the bound is read as written over the whole exterior at detection; the inner part must fall with the mesh at fixed sampling, the outer-face part with the distance of the faces and the face options). Ended: queue entry q0089 a-s1l-quarter (the run for condition (c)); q0108 a-rt2a-A ended WITHOUT completing (its chain says FAILED: `nrpic-queue show q0108`); q0109 a-rt2a-B: look. (1) Close what has ended. q0089: judge it by the rule written before it ran (does the lag of the first crossing scale as the named first-order cause predicts? what is refuted?), registered analysis, figure looked at. (2) q0108: find out from its log why the chain failed (a guard stop, a set-up error, the new build); if it is a set-up error correct it and enter it again; if it is a guard stop with non-finite fields on the release build with the faces at twice the distance and the face options, that is a finding: say at what time and where, and make the smallest reproducer on processors. Judge whatever of the retest has run against decision 0051 item 4: the ratio of scope section 3 at detection as written; the inner part against the mesh; the outer part against the distance of the faces. (3) OPEN.md with the state of conditions (a) to (d); say plainly which are met, which are not, and what each still needs; send the orchestrator one line when the second review can be asked for.

Extra for this session (about an hour). Ruling on the mesh leg of G3: decision 0051 item 3 (no run on two cards; M/8 and M/12, and a coarser member at M/6 if it qualifies: its timing run finds the horizon at t = 0 and a null test at M/6 stays within the bound of criterion N; then three members give an order; otherwise the difference of the two finer members with no order, and the refined M/16 member of G2 beside them as a cross-check). Ended: queue entry q0100 D-G3-G8 (the first production member). (1) Check that its jobs completed, close it, read it against its predictions with a registered analysis and a figure you look at (the growth law against the exact solution with the converged finder; the shells' lead carried as a bias). (2) Bring scope/SCOPE_G3.md in line with the ruling (dated), predictions for the qualifying test of M/6 first; then queue: the timing and null test of M/6, the member at M/12 (its cap from the timing you measured), and what else the amended scope allows as its next step; four entries at most; release core-v0.9 for members that are compared with each other (say in the scope which build each family uses: the deposit at level faces changed without an option, and your refined decks use compensation?: check, and keep one build per family). (3) HANDOFF with the entries and how each is read.
